content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. Let me actually say it: a birthday walk with no phone, coming back hopeful for the first time in months, that's a big deal after how heavy it's been.

And telling your team you need a real break, that's not nothing either. Two weeks starting Monday sounds like exactly what you've earned.

What's first on the list once Monday hits, sleep or something fun?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
